verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an OpenAPI spec at lium.io/api/openapi.json and stable `error.code` values. Neither establishes API versioning or a documented deprecation policy. Stable error codes are an adjacent stability guarantee, not a versioning or deprecation commitment, so no capability for this story is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
